description: Use this when the user asks LivinIsto to keep watching Slovak property listings (flats, houses, cottages, plots; for sale or rent) for them over time (e.g. "let me know until March about a 2-room flat in Žilina under 150 000 €"). This does NOT start watching by itself and takes no e-mail address or other personal data: it returns a consentUrl on www.livinisto.sk that the user must open themselves, enter their own e-mail there and confirm by clicking the link LivinIsto e-mails them. Never ask the user for their e-mail in the conversation and never open the link for them. An unconfirmed draft is deleted after 24 hours. Matching properties are e-mailed to the user and can also be read with intent_list_matches using the returned intentCode — keep it in the conversation. hiddenLimitEur is optional: the most the user would pay (for a rental, per month), stored encrypted and never shown to sellers or returned by any tool; pass it only if the user said it. Matches come from listings LivinIsto aggregates from the Slovak market (its own listings and public listings from Slovak property portals), so they cover only properties listed on LivinIsto (Slovakia only, EUR) and may be incomplete.

buyBy.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) by which the user wants to buy or rent; watching stops after it.

hiddenLimitEur.description: Optional private maximum price in EUR (for a rental, per month); encrypted on receipt and never returned by any tool.

lang.description: Optional language of the replies (texts only; codes, URLs and statuses never change). By default the language of the statement.

niceToHave.description: Wishes that are not required (never filters), e.g. "balkón, výťah".

statement.description: What the property MUST be, as one short Slovak phrase, e.g. "2-izbový byt Žilina do 150 000 €" or "prenájom 1-izbový byt Bratislava do 700 €".

name: intent_publish_intent

consentExpiresAt.description: ISO time after which the unconfirmed draft is deleted.

consentUrl.description: Page on www.livinisto.sk where the USER confirms the intent with their own e-mail. Show it unchanged.

hasHiddenLimit.description: Whether a hidden limit was stored. Its value is never returned.

intentCode.description: Secret code of this intent; use it with intent_get_intent, intent_list_matches and intent_withdraw_intent.

notUnderstood.description: Words of the statement that are NOT watched for as a filter. Tell the person.

status.description: awaiting_consent = the user has not confirmed on the LivinIsto page yet; awaiting_email_confirmation = the user filled in the page and must click the link in the e-mail; active = LivinIsto is watching; expired = the confirmation link, the buy-by date or the intent's validity ran out; withdrawn = cancelled.

understood.description: What LivinIsto will watch for, read from the statement (in Slovak). Tell the person before they confirm.

title: Watch new property listings for the user (needs the user's confirmation)
